Fixes `RangeError` thrown by the `readAsDataURL` base64 fallback (when `Buffer` is unavailable) by chunking `String.fromCharCode.apply` calls to avoid exceeding engine argument limits for large `Blob`s. **Changes:** - Added a chunked `arrayBufferToBase64` helper to safely encode large `ArrayBuffer`s in non-`Buffer` environments. - Updated `readAsDataURL` fallback path in both Edge and legacy DOM server stream configs to use the new helper. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/react-server/src/ReactServerStreamConfigEdge.js | Adds chunked `ArrayBuffer`→base64 helper and wires it into `readAsDataURL` fallback. | | packages/react-dom-bindings/src/server/ReactDOMLegacyServerStreamConfig.js | Mirrors the same helper and fallback wiring for legacy DOM server streaming. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
